rules.rule: Rules (lines) are Charcoal #2E2E2C on Off White, Oat or Warm Grey Paper, and Off White #F5F2EC on Club Navy.
Olive #6B7248 is used only for the mark's leaf and small labels, never as a ground, panel or body text.
Olive #6B7248 covers no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
Every palette colour is used solid at 100% opacity, with no tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode.
No scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.
No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons, icons or the mark, pure white and pure black included.
No gold, foil, metallic or gloss effect.
Each garment keeps the colour it was photographed in, apart from neutralising the shoot's light.
No photograph is recoloured toward a palette hex or another colourway.
No recoloured colourway variant is shown as a product.
Use the supplied olive-leaf mark (northgrove_mark_transparent.svg, northgrove_mark_reversed.svg or their PNGs) unchanged, leaf included.
Do not move the leaf of the supplied logo.
Place the supplied logo unchanged, without retyping NORTHGROVE or closing up its letters.
On light grounds the mark's leaf is Olive #6B7248.
rules.source: brand_identity.palette (Olive usage: mandatory in the mark's leaf on light grounds)

rules.rule: A style name is set larger than body text, cloth notes and colourway names.
Fine print is set smaller than body text, cloth notes and colourway names.
Preserve garment geometry.
Preserve fabric texture.
Any colourway name is spelled exactly as in northgrove_colourways.csv.
Any colourway name is one northgrove_colourways.csv approves for the style it labels.
A colourway name's description in northgrove_copy.txt matches the colour shown.
No colour name is added beyond an approved colourway name and its northgrove_copy.txt story.
Any colourway story is word for word from northgrove_copy.txt.
Name each style as northgrove_copy.txt does.
No claim, discount, product feature or slogan is invented beyond the approved copy.
No price appears, since no supplied file gives one.
Any fabric line matches northgrove_copy.txt for that style; the Supporters' Crew has none.
Any size run reads “XS S M L XL XXL”, as in northgrove_copy.txt.
No source frame is enlarged past its own pixels.
No garment is generated or extended beyond its source photograph.
Cut-out edges show no pale rim or grey paper fringe, on light grounds or on Club Navy (planned traps on the Loopback Crew and supporters' crew).
Cut-outs bite no seam, cuff or hem (planned trap on the pale Loopback Crew).
The garments look consistent: neutral light across the bright-morning and after-weather halves of the shoot (planned trap).
Preserve identity: the supporters' crew keeps its tonal RA crest.
